test_cases.description: ensureLeadingSlash prepends '/' to a bare slug without a leading slash
ensureLeadingSlash returns input unchanged when it already starts with '/'
ensureLeadingSlash returns '/' for empty string input
ensureLeadingSlash returns '/' unchanged for slash-only input
ensureLeadingSlash does NOT strip double slashes — returns input unchanged if it starts with '/'
ensureLeadingSlash is idempotent — applying it twice yields the same result as once
ensureLeadingSlash is a pure function with no side effects — same input always produces same output
ensureLeadingSlash result always starts with '/'
getNavLinkClassName returns a non-empty string with active Tailwind classes when isActive is true
test_cases.expected_output_description: Non-empty string containing active styling classes

test_cases.description: getNavLinkClassName returns a non-empty string with inactive Tailwind classes when isActive is false
test_cases.expected_output_description: Non-empty string containing inactive styling classes

test_cases.description: getNavLinkClassName returns different class strings for active vs inactive states
ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST contains exactly 13 entries
First entry in ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST is the home route with slug '/'
Every value in ROUTE_SLUG_MAP starts with exactly one leading slash
No slug value in ROUTE_SLUG_MAP produces a double-slash
All RouteSlug values across ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST are unique

test_cases.description: ROUTE_SLUG_MAP is derivable from ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST — they are consistent
